data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1910 reported a strengthening of prior year reserves amounting to GBP 28.1 million for the 2019 financial year. This adverse development is primarily attributed to losses incurred on the 2017 and 2018 underwriting years of account. The Chairman's statement highlighted a loss to capital providers from the 2017 and Prior Years of Account of GBP 17.7m, and the 2018 underwriting year also showed a loss of GBP 10.4m. These losses are linked to major loss events in 2017 and 2018, and a disappointing lack of adequate pricing response in the market. The syndicate also experienced large losses in the current year from its Marine account and former Property Insurance business, alongside a series of catastrophic events including Australian Floods, Hurricane Dorian, and Typhoons Faxai and Hagibis.

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 36 shows a release of -5.7m for UW years up to 2017, which contradicts the strengthening of 28.1m derived from the Chairman's Statement and Year of Account Summary.
